## What changes?

Describe the problem and what users can do after this change. Link related issues.

## How was it checked?

List commands, results, and anything not checked. Include screenshots for visible changes, with private data removed.

- [ ] Relevant tests, types, build, and formatting pass.
- [ ] Dashboard changes have browser checks and reviewed previews, or do not apply.
- [ ] Affected documentation, release version, and changelog are updated.
- [ ] No credentials, customer data, databases, or generated output are included.
